name: Akuno Masayoshi
source:
A former office worker who had an accidental change in profession to become an evil fighter. He has no talent or ability when it comes to fighting. However, he is the rare type of person to exude unlimited energy whenever anything erotic is involved.

No matter how badly he is treated, he always submits himself to a beautiful woman with a nice body. This may make him a fool but he can be calculating and make bold judgements to end up in more erotic situations.

[Translation from [url=http://amatures.ohimesama.net/sentou/]Official Site[/url]]
